origin: docs/CWE-79/javascript Common Pitfalls: URL-context XSS where HTML escaping does not validate dangerous schemes

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (Cross-site Scripting)
finding.summary: A profile website URL is only HTML-attribute escaped before being placed in an href, so javascript: or data: URLs still execute when a user clicks the rendered link.

trap: Escaping the href for HTML, percent-encoding the whole value, or adding CSP alone. The dangerous scheme remains the bug; a correct fix must validate the URL protocol for this URL context before rendering the link.
must_preserve: Valid http, https, and mailto profile links still render as links with the existing class and rel attribute. The display name remains HTML-escaped, and missing or rejected URLs do not turn into a broken clickable javascript/data link.
